notes.title: Fish Shop Simulator will be released on Apr 1st!
notes.content: In Fish Shop Simulator, you’re not just selling fish—you’re creating a mesmerizing aquatic experience! Design beautiful aquariums, carefully select and care for exotic fish, and impress customers with your stunning displays. Balance business and creativity as you grow your shop into the go-to destination for fish enthusiasts. Launching April 1st - dive in and start your fishkeeping journey!
